tools.name: company
tools.description: Use when an agent must verify a company (KYC/KYB, supplier or invoice check): official legal name, address, legal form, active/dissolved, LEI, register number, VAT validity. Search by name= (+country=), id=, lei= or vat=. GLEIF worldwide plus official national registers: FR, NO, FI, LV, IE, GB, US,

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Use when an agent needs an official exchange rate to convert prices, invoices or portfolios: ECB euro reference rates for ~30 currencies (USD, GBP, CHF, JPY, CNY …), latest or for any day since 1999, with any base currency (cross rates computed from the ECB fix). Returns the exact rate date. Source

tools.name: interest_rates
tools.description: Use when an agent needs today's central bank rates for loans, savings, valuation or macro answers: ECB key rates (deposit facility, main refinancing, marginal lending, with the date they took effect) and US Fed funds target range, effective fed funds rate (EFFR) and SOFR from the New York Fed. tools.name: treasury_yields
tools.description: Use when an agent needs US government bond yields, a risk-free rate or the yield curve (e.g. 2Y/10Y spread, recession signal, discounting): official US Treasury daily par yield curve, 1 month to 30 years, latest or any day since 1990 (weekends/holidays return the previous business day). Includes 10Y

tools.name: inflation
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the official inflation rate (year-on-year consumer prices) for a country: Eurostat HICP for the euro area, EU and 36 European countries (incl. CH, NO, TR) and US CPI-U from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. Latest month plus up to 36 months of history, flash estimates flagged.

tools.name: kyb
tools.description: Use before onboarding, paying or contracting a company: official register data (as /v1/company), screening of the name against the EU, US OFAC SDN and UK sanctions lists (refreshed daily) and official insolvency notices (FR BODACC, UK, CH). Sanctions hits are 'possible matches' with a 0-100 score, n
